data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alaa' meaning 'to rise above, to be exalted, noble, high-ranking'. In Islamic tradition, AlAali is a name for those who strive for spiritual elevation and are recognized for their noble character. The name AlAali carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAali usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
